_comment: H1 suppression rules for legitimately big-payload apps (plan C1 edge cases / decision D4). asset_patterns: substring match on lowercased zip entry paths. native_share_exempt: if lib/*.so uncompressed bytes exceed this share of total, the app is a genuine native-heavy app, not a packer (packer stubs ship small .so + one encrypted blob).
sha256_allowlist_note: sha256_allowlist was excluded from the publish commit (be31a2d 'sensitive artifacts excluded') and reconstructed 2026-10-04: FULL_KT section 15 requires exactly 2 sha256-allowlisted goodware among benign_eval's 100; arithmetic over the reproduced matrix (95 clean + 3 brand-matched + 2 remaining) uniquely identifies these 2 samples, both ground-truthed benign with 0 VT detections (ground_truth_check_all.csv, evaluation/gt_recheck_cache.json).
